question: Who is your favorite character, and what do you try to make sure and be concerned about when writing them?
answer: My favorite character is Emilia; she has to be an adorable character, so I need to make sure about that. Even now, writing Emilia’s lines makes me pretty nervous. I have an impression of her being cute in every line she says, so even though I can write as much as I want for other characters, I need to stop for a moment, take a breath, and think about what to write for her.
